reviews.title: Fun app. Cool concepts
reviews.text:
Steppa is a really cool concept and a fun app overall. It definitely gives you a reason to get up, start walking, and stay active, especially when you have money invested in a challenge.

My biggest complaint is the confusion around how many people are actually still participating in a challenge, how many have dropped out, and what your expected payout will be. It can be hard to tell where you actually stand throughout the challenge.

I really wish Steppa had an “Expected Payout” section that automatically updated each day based on how many participants are still eligible. That would make everything much more transparent and give users a better idea of what they could potentially win as the challenge progresses.

Overall, it’s a fun and motivating app with a great concept. A little more transparency with participant numbers and payouts would make it much better.

reviews.title: Serious Transparency Concern
reviews.text:
I really like the concept behind Steppa, but my experience with the “Push the Boulder” challenge has raised serious concerns about the accuracy and transparency of the challenge results.

During the challenge, I checked the participant list and accounts approximately 71–177 were showing 0 steps, while roughly the first 70 participants appeared to have completed the required goal. After the challenge ended, however, those same accounts appeared with exactly 3,000 steps and were included as winners.

I contacted support asking for an explanation but have not yet received a clear answer.

I am not claiming these are fake accounts because I have no way to verify that. However, when real money and prize pools are involved, participants should be able to clearly understand how steps are verified, why displayed step totals can change after a challenge, and exactly how the final number of winners and payouts are calculated.

The concept is great, but until there is more transparency around these discrepancies, I can’t confidently give the app a higher rating. I would be happy to update my review if Steppa provides a clear explanation or fixes the issue.
